notes: Diagnostic numerical gate only: no artifact, installation, promotion, default change or performance claim; gainQualified, installable, productionPerformanceClaim and scalesSerialized are always false.

realE4GateComplete is recomputed at encode time: true only when the in-process prerequisite receipt (actual component reports matched to hashed component executables and this build's selector source/IR) is valid and the full numerical qualification passed.

Per fixture: fresh direct reference; OFF control prepared (CPU routing); ON device-routing preparation in one scope. 32 frozen IDs on the previous actual argmax, full-vocabulary finite, vector and per-element normalized < 1e-4 against the same reference, ON == OFF bitPattern at every logit, exact counters with kernels OFF + 30 and command buffers OFF - 30 per forward, GPU selections and record chains 30 per forward, CPU selections 0.

Every router frame including prefill is checked against the local CPU FP64 decision recomputed from the logged GPU scores and local scales, and replayed through the component entry for record bit identity.
No scales, coefficient bits or weights are reported; the model SHA-256 is the cached explicit-refresh record and is never rehashed.
